                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For the purposes of these Terms of Use 2% Realty Bluegrass, LLC dba DIYFlatFee.com will be referred to as "Brokerage"

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Brokerage is a licensed real estate brokerage in Alabama, Florida, Kentucky, Georgia, Tennessee, Illinois and Virginia. It is a flat-fee, limited service agency.  It does not provide the same services as a “traditional” brokerage, which is why we are able to offer a reduced flat fee rather than charge the traditional 5-6% commission.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Brokerage does not actually represent you as a traditional "Seller's Agency", unless you choose the “Full Service” package.  Otherwise, Brokerage is only responsible for entering your property into the MLS database, updating the listing information accordingly, and reporting appropriate statuses to MLS.  Brokerage has limited to no editorial control over 3rd party websites.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                For your safety: there have been isolated instances of reported burglaries of homes on which lockboxes have been placed and for which the lockbox has been alleged to have been used to access the home.  In order to minimize the risk of misuse of the lockbox Brokerage recommends against the use of lockboxes on door handles that can be unscrewed from the outside or on other parts of the home from which the lockbox can be easily removed.  Since others will have access to your property you should remove all valuables or put them in a secure place.  Brokerage does not enter the lockbox code into the MLS.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Brokerage works to maintain its web site and services, but is not responsible for defects that may exist within its web site or any resulting loss of profits or other damages.  Brokerage attempts to accurately enter the information you provide into the multiple listing service.  However, Brokerage does not guarantee 100% error-free service.  If you discover any error you must promptly notify Brokerage so the error can be remedied as soon as possible. Brokerate is not responsible for any loss or damage suffered by the error.  Brokerage shall under no circumstances have any liability greater than the amount it received from you for its services.  You agree to hold Brokerage harmless from any and all claims, causes of action, or damages arising out of or relating to your providing incomplete and/or inaccurate information to Brokerage.  Seller hereby releases Brokerage and those working through Brokerage from all liability and responsibility in connection with any loss that may occur.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                When you accept an offer on your property you agree to notify Brokerage within 24 hours by updating the status through the Seller Dashboard on Brokerage.  The failure to do so will result in a $500 fine to Brokerage by the MLS, which will be passed on directly to you the seller.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                BY PURCHASING AN MLS PACKAGE YOU HAVE AGREED TO THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS STATED ABOVE. IF YOU HAVE NOT READ THESE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OR DO NOT AGREE WITH THEM, THEN YOU SHOULD NOT ACCEPT.
